acceptanceCriteria: `docs corpus build` refuses, with the same typed code, every condition that would make the index derivation refuse at query time, or the spec names the ones it cannot pre-check.
body: V1-1995 (PR #1264, DCP-V1-196) makes `docs corpus build` refuse an artifact whose query index would exceed the capacity bound, but other index derivation refusals are still discovered only when a tool first queries the artifact.
